item.name: Shooms
item.cardSummary: The main currency, earned passively by surviving and growing creatures. Shooms buy creatures from gachas, the Rotation Store, and the Trial Creatures Shop, and convert into Tikits.

item.name: Tikits
item.cardSummary: The premium-adjacent currency converted from Shooms, spent on Tokens and the Tikit gachas: Royalty, Celestial, and Mystery.

item.name: Time Points
item.cardSummary: Earned by keeping creatures alive over time and spent in the Time Points Shop on its rotating creature stock.

item.name: Daily Points
item.cardSummary: The login-streak currency, accumulating from daily play and feeding its own reward track.

item.name: Candy
item.cardSummary: The Halloween event currency, collected during spooky events and spent in that event's shop before it closes.

item.name: Candy Canes
item.cardSummary: The Christmas event currency for the winter shop's limited stock.

item.name: Clovers
item.cardSummary: The St. Patrick's event currency of the luck-themed shop.

item.name: Corrupted Shooms
item.cardSummary: A twisted event variant of Shooms minted for its corruption-themed event.

item.name: Eggs
item.cardSummary: The Easter event currency, gathered during egg events.

item.name: Pearls
item.cardSummary: The summer event currency of the aquatic shops.

item.name: Stamps
item.cardSummary: An event currency tied to its travel-themed event window.
